records.prompt: Draw an animation director's whole-character WALK pose sheet for THIS SAME white-haired adult swordsman, consistent black long coat/red lining, red wrapped forearms, dark fitted pants, silver knee guards and black boots. Reference1 identity, reference2 current painted rendering/anatomy. Requested canvas 2560x1440, transparent. Exactly THREE complete separate full-body figures in one horizontal row, all facing SCREEN RIGHT, identical scale, identical adult proportions and compact heads (about seven full hair-to-chin head heights per standing body). Shared ground baseline and generous gaps, no overlapping silhouettes, nothing cropped. LEFT: neutral standing straight companion for scale calibration, relaxed empty hands. MIDDLE: WALK contact with near anatomical RIGHT leg extended forward SCREEN RIGHT, heel touching ground and toe slightly lifted; far LEFT leg behind SCREEN LEFT with heel raised and toe supporting. RIGHT: the OPPOSITE WALK contact, far LEFT leg extended forward SCREEN RIGHT and heel contacting; near anatomical RIGHT leg behind SCREEN LEFT on toe with heel raised. IMPORTANT middle and right MUST have opposite anatomical legs in front, not duplicated same-leg pose. Use the original near right thigh strap detail and correct leg occlusion so swap is readable. Draw each entire figure as one anatomically connected body: pelvis rotated over advancing leg, shoulders counter-rotate gently, slight torso/head height change with weight transfer, knees aligned with hips/ankles. Natural moderate grounded stride, no lunging, no crouch, no floating. Arms counter-swing softly: primary right hand stays low beside rear/side hip in a relaxed empty cylindrical sword grip, left arm counter-swings with advancing opposite leg. Coat moves with pelvis, hem opens just enough to reveal both leg paths; coat never replaces a thigh. No weapons, no scabbards, no labels/numbers, no guide skeleton, no detached parts, no effects or motion blur. This is fully painted intact anatomy in each pose, NOT a cutout puppet and NOT a parts sheet. Match body/face/style across all three.
records.review_note: Both contact figures repeat near leg forward; hands not prepared for carry.
